conditions.name: Feed alive
conditions.threshold: met after 300 s with no new operation

conditions.name: Custody healthy
conditions.threshold: met at any partial or unknown receipt, or a custody stop

conditions.name: Not looping
conditions.threshold: met at 30 or more decisions without play while game time does not advance

conditions.name: Spend inside allowance
conditions.threshold: met when spend or the one-hour projection exceeds the manifest ceiling

conditions.name: Not dead and still spending
conditions.threshold: met at a death followed by further requests
